cohort: 52 children with ASD and 201 normal children
finding: Preterm gestational age, caesarean delivery, abnormal fetal presentation during labor, and complications during labor were significantly associated with an increased risk of ASD.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a decreased risk of ASD, while abnormal fetal presentation during labor was associated with an increased risk of ASD.
gest_age: Preterm gestational age was significantly associated with ASD
